# GOV.UK Frontend 6.6.0

Vendored from the MIT-licensed `govuk-frontend` package so GitHub Pages can serve the prototype without a build step or a CDN.

- Source: https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-frontend
- Version: 6.6.0
- License: MIT
- Font files are the GDS Transport files shipped with that package.
- The GOV.UK crest is not included. This prototype does not use the crown logo.

CSS `url(/assets/fonts/...)` paths were rewritten to `url(assets/fonts/...)` so the fonts resolve next to the stylesheet.
